canonical_project: ADETIC Community Multimedia Center / antenna Abeche
owner: ADETIC (state agency); PATN (World Bank digital transformation project) partner for local mechanisms
notes: ADETIC operates an active antenna/multimedia center in Abeche (Ouaddai): digital-inclusion training series ('Vacance Numerique 2026') organized Dec 2025 (Dari-Infos, B; center head Mahamat Abdallah Samil), and PATN installed its complaints-management committee at ADETIC Abeche in June 2026 (govserv, B). One of six ADETIC multimedia telecentres built/equipped nationwide. Institutional ICT/telecentre facility; NOT a commercial data center.
